attributes.board_name: New York State Board of Pharmacy (NYSED Office of the Professions)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Formal courses from approved sponsors: ACPE-approved sponsors or equivalent (e.g. relevant AMA CME), registered/accredited degree-granting institutions, or sponsors approved by the Department; one CPR/BLS/ACLS/EMT course per period from listed organizations
rules.new_licensee_rule: Not exempt: newly licensed pharmacists must meet the requirement in their first three-year registration period; shorter periods prorated at 1.25 hours per month.
rules.audit_note: Random audits; keep records 6 years. Compliance is certified under penalty of perjury at registration.

topics.who: Strategies and techniques to reduce medication and prescription errors (home study or live)

rules.notes: At least 23 of 45 hours must be live (real-time interaction); self-study max 22 hours. Also 3 hours on pharmaceutical compounding each period since 1/1/23 (no topic code). Renewal fee includes a $45 CE fee. One-year conditional registration possible if deficient.
